NHAI Wins Rs 1,202 Crore Arbitration Award in Karnataka Highway Dispute

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has secured a significant arbitration award of Rs 1,202 crore concerning a highway dispute in Karnataka. This legal victory provides financial relief and demonstrates progress in resolving contractual disagreements within infrastructure projects. The NHAI also reportedly received another form of relief related to an Assam project, though details were not provided.
